deposits.interpretation: Delaware sets the filing method from the tax reported in a look-back period, July 1 to June 30 immediately before the calendar year: $6,020.00 or less is QUARTERLY; $6,020.01 to $33,460.00 is MONTHLY; $33,460.01 or more is EIGHTH-MONTHLY. An employer with no prior record of withholding files MONTHLY until the next look-back. The Division mails the vouchers for the method it assigns, so the method is an INPUT or is derived from a supplied look-back liability. Monthly: Form W-1, by the 15th of the month after the month. Quarterly: Form W-1Q, by the last day of the month after the quarter. Eighth-monthly: Form W-1A; each month has eight payment periods ending on the 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, 19th, 22nd, 25th and the last day, and payment is due within 3 days (exclusive of weekends and state holidays) after the period end, which this profile reads as the 3rd business day after the period end. Withholding is reported in the month the payroll is completed (by the pay date), and a due date on a weekend or state holiday moves to the next working day. Eighth-monthly filers file no quarterly reconciliation, only the annual one (Form W-3, due February 28).

lookback.description: Delaware income tax reported in the look-back period July 1 to June 30 before the calendar year

returns.name: Form W-1, monthly withholding return
contents: Filed with the payment by the 15th of the month after the month.

returns.name: Form W-1Q, quarterly withholding return
contents: Filed with the payment by the last day of the month after the quarter.

returns.name: Form W-1A, eighth-monthly withholding return
contents: Filed with the payment within 3 days (not counting weekends and state holidays) after each period end: the 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, 19th, 22nd, 25th and last day of the month.

returns.name: Form W-3, Annual Reconciliation/Transmittal of Income Tax Withheld
contents: Due on or before February 28 for the preceding calendar year, filed with a duplicate copy of each federal Form W-2 showing the Delaware tax withheld.
Employees receive their W-2 by January 31.
A common paymaster may not remit for multiple employers on one return; each employer reports under its own FEIN.

returns.name: Quarterly Contribution and Wage Report (Forms UC-8 and UC-8A)
contents: Filed (postmarked) on or before the last day of the month after the quarter, even if no wages were paid; payment for any tax liability goes with it.
A $17.25 fine applies when the report is submitted more than five days after the due date, and interest accrues at 1.5% a month on unpaid tax (handbook).
